def.brief: Write the tests for Q-hostcall into test_dwitbuk.py (free functions named test_Q_hostcall_..., this file's helpers, its own __main__ runner). Drive dwitbuk's two real adapter entry points, eyes_worker.claude(packet, schema, args) and eyes_worker.codex(packet, schema, args), with subprocess.run replaced by a recorder so no host process starts (give each adapter what it needs to finish or catch its SystemExit after the call is recorded). With a parent environment that sets AGENT_HOST to the other host, CODEX_THREAD_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, CHONGDAE_SESSION, AI_AGENT, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and CODEX_VERSION, plus CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, CLAUDECODE and AGENT_CODEX_SANDBOX (dummy values), assert the env each child got: AGENT_HOST=claude-code for claude and codex for codex, AGENT_WORKER=1, none of the six parent identity/metadata keys, every config/auth/marker key kept with its value, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 on the claude call, the codex argv's -s value equal to AGENT_CODEX_SANDBOX when set and read-only when unset; and os.environ equal before and after each call. The current hostcall.py predates this contract, so these tests fail now: show that with the real suite (python3 test_dwitbuk.py) or a focused python3 -c run, never python3 -m unittest. Change no file but test_dwitbuk.py; do not commit.

response.summary: I added 9 Q-hostcall tests to test_dwitbuk.py as free functions named test_Q_hostcall_…. They use the file's own __main__ runner and a new `import argparse`. Two helpers drive the real eyes_worker.claude and eyes_worker.codex adapters with subprocess.run swapped for a recorder. The recorder answers exit 1, so no host process starts, and the SystemExit that follows the recorded call is caught. hostcall_parent builds a parent environment that claims to be the other host: it sets AGENT_HOST plus the six identity/metadata keys, the config/auth/marker keys, and an optional AGENT_CODEX_SANDBOX. hostcall_call lays that over os.environ (with AGENT_WORKER, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY and AGENT_CODEX_SANDBOX taken out first) and snapshots os.environ before and after the call. Afterwards it restores both os.environ and subprocess.run. I ran `python3 test_dwitbuk.py` and it exits 1. All 9 new tests fail against the current hostcall.py for the contract's reasons: the child gets the parent's AGENT_HOST (e.g. 'codex' on the claude call) and the six parent identity keys. The tests themselves load and run without errors. One test I did not write also fails: test_session_start_hook_says_what_the_placed_reviews_still_need_and_nothing_else, with a JSONDecodeError. It fails the same way with the HEAD version of the file, so my change did not cause it.
